Maria (Marketing): Draft is ready for review — https://docs.google.com/d/abc123 Please scan hero quote, benchmark callout, and webinar CTA. Target publish Thu Apr 15 9am PT. @Priya can you quick legal read? @Jess can you confirm hero image? @Noah can you confirm webinar RSVP flow?

Sam (Product): Quick skim — looks good. Two quick items: the p3 latency stat needs a source link, and I think we should swap the 2nd and 3rd paragraphs for better flow.

Jess (Design): Uploaded hero options to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz I prefer option B (lighter bg). Will export social card sizes (1200x628, 800x800) and drop them in the doc. :+1:

Noah (Growth): RSVP flow details: we'll use a HubSpot form embed + UTM tracking. Do we want to gate the benchmark whitepaper behind the form or let it be free download? If gated, I'll wire the nurture flow and lead scoring.

Maria (Marketing): Let's gate the benchmark whitepaper behind HS form. UTMs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch` Add `utm_term=benchmark` on the whitepaper CTA.

Priya (Legal): Quick pass done. One note: the customer quote on para 4 needs anonymization (remove company name/replace with "a Series B fintech"). Also add a short privacy blurb near the form: "We may email registrants about product updates and related events."

Maria (Marketing): Thanks @Priya — I'll anonymize the quote. @PublishBot can you schedule a final review meeting for tomorrow 11:00 AM PT? Need everyone there for final signoff.

PublishBot: Meeting scheduled — Tue Apr 8 11:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent to Maria (Marketing), Sam (Product), Jess (Design), Noah (Growth), Priya (Legal).

Sam (Product): Tiny nit: when we mention latency, can we add the metric format? e.g., "15–25 ms (p95)" instead of just "~20ms". Makes the claim more concrete.

Maria (Marketing): Good call. Updated paragraph and added `(p95)` after the latency stat. Pushed changes to the doc.

Jess (Design): Design sign-off — exported hero image and social cards, updated open graph meta in the doc. I also optimized the hero for mobile crop.

Noah (Growth): Growth green light. I'll create the HubSpot form, add the gating for the whitepaper, and set up the nurture cadence + lead scoring. I'll also add the UTM parameters and a webhook to forward qualified leads to CSM.

Priya (Legal): Legal OK to publish pending final redaction check on a screenshot (contains a customer name). Maria please confirm redaction done in the draft.

Maria (Marketing): Redacted the screenshot and replaced with anonymized example. Final publish window: Thu Apr 15 09:00 AM PT. Please give a final :thumbsup: or flag by EOD tomorrow so we can lock schedule.

Sam (Product): :thumbsup: from me — no other blockers.

PublishBot: Scheduled publish: Thu Apr 15 09:00 AM PT. CDN purge, social queue, and analytics tagging set. Preview live at https://redwood.ai/blog/optimize-launch-preview

Maria (Marketing): Thanks team — will follow up in the review meeting with a final pre-publish checklist.
